source.check: every name read from the page image; no contest after withdrawals, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 28 May 1914: contests in Ballymartrim, Brootally, Clady, Glenaul and Middletown. Labels are printed only in the results of the contests. Returned unopposed. George Fleming: no party label printed in 1914. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Newtownhamilton, Armagh County Council, 28 May 1914, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 5 June 1914, p. 3 ("Armagh County Council"); candidates in the Armagh Guardian, 8 May 1914, p. 3 ("County Council Contests")).
